links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT-3.5 post-BPH-surgery responses graded by urology residents against predefined criteria
links.effect: Of 216 graded responses, 78.2% comprehensive and correct, 9.3% incomplete or partially correct, 10.2% mixed accurate and inaccurate, 2.3% entirely incorrect.
links.quote: Among the 216 graded responses, 78.2% were comprehensive and correct, 9.3% were incomplete or partially correct, 10.2% contained a mix of accurate and inaccurate information, and 2.3% were entirely incorrect.

screen.reason: Evaluates the factual validity and completeness of ChatGPT-3.5 responses to post-operative BPH patient queries without evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
